properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_null_unsets_at_every_typed_constructor.rs, driven through call_tool as a session reaches it. Membership: every served add_* tool and every tool promising "optional to revise" (24 today; the test fails below 23 and on any constructor that asks no property). For each, the create a_revise_keeps_what_it_was_not_passed.rs synthesises plus list properties; then (1) a revise with only the id keeps every stored property; (2) for each optional property the node type declares and the create stored, `null` removes it or puts back its schema default (add_inference's name: its computed default), names it under `unset`, changes no other property, and leaves the node revisable by id; (3) a null on a required property (schema-required, or needed to create, confirmed by a create without it being refused for it) is refused naming it and writes nothing. Nine structural add_inference fields that name parts of a proof are listed as not asked, with why.
properties.findings: Observed failing first on main 9638e16b9's source (commit cdd92f144): 307 problems across all 24 constructors, add_constraint's `limit: null` leaving limit = 0.4 among them, no reply naming `unset`, and every null on a required property accepted. Passing after 87fb5a815, with the MCP crate's whole in-memory suite (887 + 257 + 18 tests) and clippy -D warnings clean.
properties.name: A null unsets at every typed constructor, left out keeps (1 table-driven MCP test)
